name: Southwest Tennessee Community College
tuition_note: 2025-26 in-state (resident) tuition & fees $5,217/yr and room & board $10,000/yr from official Cost of Attendance page (southwest.tn.edu/financial-aid/cost-of-attendance.php). Public community college; the $10,000 is a combined estimated room+board living allowance, not a room-only on-campus dorm rate (Southwest is a commuter college with no traditional dorms). Consistent with bursar tuition page (southwest.tn.edu/financial-and-administrative-services/bursars-office/tuition.php) showing ~$2,542/semester full-time fees at $197/credit hour.
